title: Evidence record
description: What `govkit evidence --record` observed straight after a test run: the commit, a digest of the working tree, and the result files present. `govkit evidence --feature` counts results only while this still describes the repository. A record is an observation. It does not show that the tests ran, and it can be written again without running them.

commit.description: The commit checked out when the record was written.

tree_digest.description: A digest of the commit, the index and every modified, deleted or untracked file Git does not ignore, leaving out the result files and this record.

clean.description: True when nothing differed from the commit apart from the result files and this record.

recorded_at.description: When the record was written, in UTC.

path.description: Relative to the target, with forward slashes.
